content.title: About
content.content: Pancakes and Sausage is a ready‑to‑heat frozen meal that includes soft wheat pancakes and sliced cooked sausages. It is designed for quick preparation in a microwave or on the stovetop. One serving provides a balanced mix of carbohydrates and protein.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The pancakes are made from whole‑grain flour, increasing dietary fiber content.
The sausages are a blend of beef and pork without artificial colorings.
The product undergoes flash‑freezing (IQF) to preserve taste and texture.
Each package contains about 250 g of product, roughly 350 kcal per serving.
Pancakes and Sausage are often used in school cafeterias as a convenient lunch option.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: The sausages provide approximately 10 g of protein per serving, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Energy supply
items.content: Carbohydrates from the pancakes quickly replenish glycogen stores, useful for active lifestyles.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain flour adds fiber, promoting healthy digestion.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The meal contains thiamine, niacin, and vitamin B6, which are involved in energy metabolism.

items.title: Low added sugar
items.content: Unlike many sweet frozen meals, this product contains minimal added sugars.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The pancakes contain wheat flour, making the product unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The sausages may contain up to 600 mg of sodium per serving; individuals monitoring salt intake should account for this.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Small amounts of preservatives may be used to extend shelf life, which could be a concern for sensitive individuals.

items.title: Proper heating required
items.content: Insufficiently heated meals can harbor bacteria, so follow the recommended heating times.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Allow the package to thaw at room temperature for about 5 minutes. Then microwave on high power for 2–3 minutes, or heat in a skillet with a little oil, covering with a lid until hot. Let stand for 1 minute before serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen meal in a freezer at –18 °C or lower. After opening, consume within 24 hours and store the remaining portion in the refrigerator at up to 4 °C.
